tools.name: add_notes_to_clip
tools.description:
REPLACES the clip's entire note content with the given notes. Use edit_notes
to add or remove a subset without touching the rest.

notes: list of {"pitch": 0-127 (60 = C3 in Live's naming), "start_time": beats
from clip start (float), "duration": beats, "velocity": 1-127, "mute": bool}.
Precondition: the clip must exist (create_clip first).

tools.name: adg_analyze
tools.description:
Full offline analysis of a .adg rack or .adv preset: named macros
(name/value), the chain + device tree (recursive, incl. racks-inside-racks
with each device's kind/name/on-state and any sample), legacy macro->
parameter mappings, every referenced sample (name + relative path), the
required Live edition, and — for drum racks — the pad map (pad -> MIDI note,
label, and sample). No Live required.

tools.name: adg_edition
tools.description:
Classify the Live edition a saved .adg/.adv needs, offline: 'suite' if any
Suite-only device is present (Operator, Wavetable, Echo, Drift, Meld,
Sampler, Collision, ...), else 'standard' if any Standard-only device is
present (EQ Eight, Compressor, Simpler, Impulse, Drum Rack, ...), else
'intro'. Returns the verdict plus which devices drove it, so an agent can
tell whether a preset will load on the user's edition before loading it.

tools.name: adg_summary
tools.description:
Summarize a saved .adg rack or .adv device preset WITHOUT Live running:
name, rack type, total device count, top-level chain count, named-macro
count, required Live edition (intro/standard/suite), and whether it is a drum
kit (`is_drum_rack` is true when the preset is or wraps a Drum Rack — factory
kits ship wrapped in an Instrument Rack). `path` is a filesystem path to a
.adg or .adv file.

tools.name: als_details
tools.description:
Read mixing and arrangement detail from a saved .als, offline: the set's
locators (name + beat time) and each track's fader volume, pan, and number of
automation lanes. Complements als_summary for reviewing a mix without Live.

tools.name: als_detect_key
tools.description:
Detect the key/scale of a saved .als file WITHOUT Live running
(Krumhansl-Kessler). Pools notes from every MIDI clip in the set, or only
one track when `track_index` is given. `weight` selects the histogram
weighting ("duration", "velocity", "product", "count"). `path` is a
filesystem path to a .als file.

tools.name: als_diff
tools.description:
Diff two saved .als files (e.g. song_v4.als vs song_v5.als) offline:
tempo/time-signature changes, tracks added/removed by name, and per-track
deltas in device chain, clip count, note count, and mute state. Great for
logging what changed between versions.

tools.name: als_extract_midi
tools.description:
Extract MIDI notes from a track in a saved .als file, as
{pitch,start,duration,velocity} dicts per clip. `track_index` is the track's
position in the set (see als_summary). No Live required.

tools.name: als_find_unfinished
tools.description:
Lint a saved .als for likely-unfinished work, offline: no master
limiter/compressor, MIDI track with no instrument, MIDI clip with no notes,
empty audio track, or muted tracks. Returns machine-readable issues so an
agent can decide what to fix before rendering.

tools.name: als_list_tracks
tools.description:
List every track in a saved .als file with its clips (name, MIDI/audio,
start, length, looping, sample path, note count). No Live required.

tools.name: als_summary
tools.description:
Summarize a saved .als file WITHOUT Live running: version/creator, tempo,
time signature, and each track's kind, name, mute/solo, device names, clip
count, and note count. `path` is a filesystem path to a .als file.

tools.name: analyze_audio_describe
tools.description:
Ask the pinned third-party Music Flamingo model on Replicate a question about a
local audio file (harmony, structure, timbre, lyrics). Requires REPLICATE_API_TOKEN and
uploads the file; nothing else in this package leaves the machine. A language-model
description, not measurement: treat tempo, key and structure claims as unverified.

tools.name: analyze_audio_file
tools.description:
Measure local WAV (integer/float), AIFF/AIFF-C, FLAC, Ogg Vorbis, MP3,
AAC or M4A/MP4 (AAC/ALAC) without Live: per-channel sample peak/RMS dBFS,
DC offset, crest factor and full-scale samples. Analyzes the first max_seconds
(default 30, maximum 120); marks partial results. Not LUFS or true peak. No upload.
Compressed files are measured after decoding; this does not recover lost audio.
Files are read locally without modification, normalization or upload.

tools.name: analyze_energy
tools.description:
Measure RMS, flux and five band envelopes per sixteenth note in a bounded local
PCM WAV window, each normalized 0..1. The band split is a one-pole cascade, so treat
the bands as relative movement, not calibrated spectrum or LUFS. Unsupported formats
fail explicitly. No Live access or changes.

tools.name: analyze_frequency_clash
tools.description:
Compare two local PCM WAV files band by band and rank where their energy
overlaps, with EQ Eight band numbers and a starting cut suggestion. Overlap is not
automatically a problem: level and arrangement decide, so audition first. Read-only.

tools.name: analyze_mix
tools.description:
Heuristic session-state checks, NOT audio, peak, LUFS or headroom measurements.
Scan the current live set for inspection leads: several high faders, a muted
or empty Session track, or a MIDI track without devices. External routing and
Arrangement audio may explain these states. Returns machine-readable
findings so you can decide what to fix. Reads the session; changes nothing.

tools.name: analyze_song_structure
tools.description:
Ask the pinned third-party All-In-One model on Replicate for BPM, key, labelled
segments, beats and downbeats of a local audio file. Requires REPLICATE_API_TOKEN and
uploads the file; nothing else in this package leaves the machine. target_bpm pins the
tempo search. Third-party output: verify every boundary before editing. No Live access.

tools.name: analyze_warp_audio
tools.description:
Estimate tempo and candidate downbeats from a bounded local PCM WAV window.
Returns measured onset events, heuristic confidence, half/double alternatives,
loop-edge discontinuity estimate and warp-mode guidance. Not audio audition.
Unsupported files fail explicitly; no Live access or changes.

tools.name: annotate_arrangement
tools.description:
Create Arrangement locators at measured level changes in a local PCM WAV, named
prefix + index + energy class. Refuses while the transport plays. Boundaries are level
changes, not confirmed song sections: listen before trusting a split.

tools.name: apply_audio_repair
tools.description:
Lower unity clip gain, enable Utility DC, and load one gentle Compressor
where the measurement supports it. Writes unless confirm is false. Refuses
while playing or recording. Does not add a limiter, write fades, or change
notes, Warp, track faders, or a compressor that is already loaded. A missing
parameter is left unset.

tools.name: apply_bass_movement
tools.description: Write rhythmic wobble/growl/yoi/pluck/sweep/machinegun/duck automation to a Session clip, then verify readback. low/high normalized within native parameter range. parameter_name=track_volume controls mixer gain. Duck requires explicit kick_times in this clip's beat timeline; not audio-reactive sidechain. Existing target envelopes require replace=true. No Arrangement mutation.

tools.name: apply_instrument_assignment
tools.description:
Load a stock placeholder on each MIDI track that still has notes and no
instrument. Writes unless confirm is false. Refuses while playing or recording.
The placeholder is there so the part can be heard; replace it. Does not change
notes, Warp, or faders.

tools.name: apply_recipe
tools.description:
Scaffold a genre starter in one call: set the tempo, add Drums, Bass, and
Chords MIDI tracks, try to load fitting instruments, and write generated
parts. `name` is one from list_recipes (e.g. "lofi_beat", "house_groove").
tempo/key/scale/bars override the recipe defaults. Adds new tracks; it does
not overwrite existing ones.

tools.name: apply_song_draft
tools.description:
Create the planned MIDI tracks at the end of the song, one Session clip
each, and Arrangement locators that are not already within 0.001 beats.
Writes unless confirm is false. Refuses while the transport plays or the
meter is not 4/4. Does not start playback, delete Arrangement clips, rename
an existing locator, or change the meter. Tempo changes only when the plan
sets apply_tempo. Tracks, clips and notes are one undo step. Locators
are separate commands.

tools.name: apply_track_alignment
tools.description:
Set Warp modes on arrangement audio that is already warped. Writes unless
confirm is false. Refuses while playing or recording. Does not enable Warp,
move markers, slide clips, or change notes, faders, polarity, EQ, sends,
automation, racks, or groups.

tools.name: apply_track_preparation
tools.description:
Duplicate each working track, mute the untouched copy, fold it when it is a
group, then rename and color the working track from its content. Writes unless
confirm is false. Refuses while playing or recording. Notes, Warp and faders stay.

tools.name: apply_warp_repair
tools.description:
Apply a reviewed preview to a non-overlapping duplicate ONLY. Saves the
source timing/plan before writing. Refuses stale/expired tokens and changed
files/targets, validates every marker, verifies original unchanged. Never
starts playback or replaces the original. After a timeout, inspect state;
token cannot be replayed. Needs EXT.5 Live bridge and actual marker API.

tools.name: artist_bass_catalog
tools.description: Artist-informed bass methods: ALLEYCVT, Subtronics, VULPER and Ray Volpe / Volpetron. Distinguishes direct-interview findings, release metadata and original native patches. VULPER processing is undocumented. Read-only; use create_native_bass separately for the four original patch recipes. No audio analysis, artist-preset loading or exact track reconstruction.

tools.name: audit_warp_clip
tools.description:
Read Session/Arrangement warp timing and optionally analyze its source WAV.
Checks marker order/slopes/drift, explicit bar length, source BPM versus mapping,
transient alignment and exact-window seam. Groove straight|triplet|swing.
Flags are structural errors or review candidates, never automatic repairs.
target uses track_index, clip_index, clip_view and optional name/start guards.

tools.name: back_to_arranger
tools.description:
Return playback control to the Arrangement (after Session clips have
overridden arrangement content - the orange 'Back to Arrangement' state).

tools.name: bass_design_catalog
tools.description: Research-backed native bass methods for dubstep, brostep and tearout. Returns original recipes, chain settings, movement suggestions and primary-source links. No Live changes; not copies of artist presets.

tools.name: bass_resampling_workflow
tools.description: Return an honest resampling workflow and exposed-tool limits. This tool does NOT record, render, route or export audio.

tools.name: batch_commands
tools.description:
Run several commands in ONE round-trip and ONE undo step (atomic-ish:
stops at the first error; completed steps are a single undo away).

commands = [{"type": "<command>", "params": {...}}, ...]. Command names match
the MCP tool names (the few that differ are auto-translated), e.g.
[{"type": "set_tempo", "params": {"tempo": 80}},
 {"type": "create_midi_track", "params": {"index": -1}}].
Composite tools (record_section, load_drum_kit, apply_recipe, save_set, the
generate_* tools) are NOT batchable - they orchestrate multiple commands
server-side. Prefer this for multi-step edits: fewer round-trips, one undo
reverts all.

tools.name: batch_warp_audit
tools.description:
Read-only audit of up to 256 explicit clip targets, with per-clip failures,
source-analysis deduplication and a 45-second batch budget. Max 8 unique WAV
windows, 15 seconds each; returns explicit skipped/unverified coverage. No
recoloring, marker changes or playback. Process further targets in another batch.

tools.name: build_remix_session
tools.description:
Build/update only this private project's named owned tracks in Live. Recheck sources,
map the loaded kit's actual pads, create native instruments and bounded automation,
and verify MIDI/Arrangement readback. New tracks start muted. Same bounds on rebuild;
source tracks stay intact. Requires stopped transport and matching tempo. Partial
failures retain a journal and are never blindly replayed. No automatic save.

tools.name: capture_and_insert_scene
tools.description:
Snapshot the currently playing Session clips into a new scene - the
'keep that combination' workflow.

tools.name: capture_midi
tools.description:
Grab recently played MIDI into a new clip (Live's Capture MIDI). Requires
that MIDI was recently played into an armed/monitored track.

tools.name: clear_automation
tools.description:
Delete one device parameter's entire automation envelope from a clip.

Resolve the device and parameter with get_device_parameters first. This
removes every automation point for that parameter, not a time range; manual
parameter state remains. Use write_automation to replace the envelope with
new points, or undo immediately to recover an accidental clear.

track_index.description: Zero-based index of a regular track in the Live set.
track_index.title: Track Index

clip_index.description: Zero-based Session-view clip-slot index on the track.
clip_index.title: Clip Index

device_index.description: Zero-based device position in the target track's device chain.
device_index.title: Device Index

parameter.description: Parameter name or zero-based parameter index returned by the matching get_*_device_parameters tool.
parameter.title: Parameter

tools.name: clip_operation
tools.description:
Structural clip edits. op: "duplicate_loop" (double the loop, duplicating
notes - extend 2 bars to 4 before adding variation), "crop" (discard
material outside the loop), "duplicate_region" (copy notes from
region_start/region_length to destination_time, optionally transposing by
transposition_amount semitones; pitch=-1 means all pitches).

tools.name: compare_remix_previews
tools.description:
Create A/B WAVs matched by measured integrated LUFS, or explicitly labeled RMS
fallback. Attenuate only, preserve source files, refuse mismatched durations.
Returns source/variant measurements and gain adjustments; no preference claim.

tools.name: compare_warp_reference
tools.description:
Compare explicit measured/reference event times in a shared beat coordinate
system. Suggests a constant offset; no automatic matching of instrument roles,
phrase structure or groove. Does not modify Live.

tools.name: continue_playing
tools.description:
Resume playback from the current position (start_playback restarts from
the playhead's last start point instead).

tools.name: create_arrangement_audio_clip
tools.description:
Import an audio file onto an audio track's Arrangement at a free beat.
The path must already exist. Refuses a position inside an existing clip,
and removes the import if its length overlaps another clip. Does not start
playback. One Live Undo step. Needs the EXT.13 bridge. Session import
remains create_audio_clip.

tools.name: create_audio_clip
tools.description:
Create a new audio clip in an audio track's clip slot by importing a file.

Requires Ableton Live 12.0.5 or newer - the underlying
ClipSlot.create_audio_clip Live API was introduced in 12.0.5 and is not
available in earlier 12.0.x releases.

Parameters:
- track_index: The index of the audio track to create the clip in
- clip_index: The index of the clip slot to create the clip in
- path: Absolute path to a supported audio file (e.g. a .wav). The target
  track must be an audio track and the clip slot must be empty.

tools.name: create_audio_track
tools.description:
Insert an empty audio track at a chosen position, or append with `-1`.

Non-negative indices insert before the current track at that position and
shift it and later track indices up. Use create_midi_track for instruments
and MIDI clips, or create_return_track for a shared send-effect bus.

index.description: Insertion position among regular tracks; -1 appends at the end.
index.title: Index

tools.name: create_bass_phrase
tools.description: Create a deterministic call/response/sub MIDI phrase in an EMPTY Session slot. Styles tearout/tearout_triplet/brostep/dubstep/halftime. Does not replace notes, change tempo, launch playback, or edit Arrangement. Preview first with preview_bass_design.

tools.name: create_clip
tools.description:
Create an empty MIDI clip in a Session slot. Fails if the slot already has
a clip (pick another clip_index or delete_clip first) or the track is an
audio track. length is in beats (4.0 = one 4/4 bar).
Typical chain: create_clip -> add_notes_to_clip -> fire_clip or
duplicate_to_arrangement.

tools.name: create_locator
tools.description:
Create or rename an Arrangement locator at an absolute beat position.

SIDE EFFECT: first moves the Arrangement playhead to `time`, because Live
creates cues at the playhead. If a locator already exists there, it is reused
and renamed when `name` is provided. Use set_arrangement_time when only the
playhead should move, and get_locators to inspect existing markers.

time.description: Position in beats from the start of the Arrangement.
time.title: Time

name.description: Optional display name; omit it to keep Live's generated name.
name.title: Name

tools.name: create_midi_track
tools.description:
Create a new MIDI track in the Ableton session.

Parameters:
- index: The index to insert the track at (-1 = end of list)

tools.name: create_native_bass
tools.description: Build a NEW track with an original native bass patch, matching effects, verified parameters and a Session MIDI phrase. Choose recipes from bass_design_catalog. Preserves existing tracks, tempo and Arrangement; does not start playback. Optional movement requires envelope bridge. Multi-operation build: on failure, a named partial new track remains for inspection.

tools.name: create_return_track
tools.description: Create a new return track (a send bus, e.g. for shared reverb or delay).

tools.name: create_scene
tools.description: Create a new scene (row of clip slots). index -1 appends at the end.

tools.name: create_structure_track
tools.description:
Build a MIDI structure track whose notes mark measured energy sections of a local
PCM WAV: pitch 84 high, 79 mid, 74 low, one note per section. Creates a new MIDI track
and a Session clip, then leaves duplication into the Arrangement to you. Refuses while
the transport plays. Energy classes are measured, not musical labels.

tools.name: create_take_lane
tools.description:
Add a take lane to a track (for comping multiple recorded takes on one
track). Returns the new take-lane count.

tools.name: delete_arrangement_clip
tools.description:
Delete a clip from the Arrangement timeline by its position in
get_arrangement_clips' list. NOTE: indices of later clips on the same track
shift down by one after each delete - re-read get_arrangement_clips between
deletes.

tools.name: delete_chain
tools.description:
Remove one chain from a rack, refusing the last remaining chain and any name
mismatch, then verify the count shrank by exactly one. One Live Undo step.
Needs the EXT.12 bridge.

tools.name: delete_clip
tools.description:
Delete the existing Session-view clip in a slot, including its content.

This leaves the slot empty and does not shift other slot indices. It fails
for an empty slot. Use stop_clip if the intent is only to stop playback;
use undo immediately if the deletion was accidental.

track_index.description: Zero-based index of a regular track in the Live set.
track_index.title: Track Index

clip_index.description: Zero-based Session-view clip-slot index on the track.
clip_index.title: Clip Index

tools.name: delete_cue_point
tools.description:
Delete the single Arrangement locator at that beat position and verify the count
dropped by one. Live has no direct cue delete, so this moves the playhead to the cue,
toggles the cue there and restores the previous playhead. Refuses when no cue sits at
that time or when several do. Needs the EXT.12 bridge.

tools.name: delete_device
tools.description:
Delete a device from a track's chain by its position (0-based). Shifts the
indices of later devices, so re-read the chain afterwards.

tools.name: delete_live_clip_notes
tools.description:
Delete existing notes by note_id from a Session or Arrangement MIDI clip.
Untouched notes keep their identity and expression data. Identical pitch and
start-time pairs are refused before any write because Live addresses notes by
window, not by ID. Verified by readback; one Undo step.

tools.name: delete_return_track
tools.description: Delete a return track by index (0 = Return A). Later returns shift down.

tools.name: delete_scene
tools.description: Delete a scene (row). Later scene indices shift down by one.

tools.name: delete_track
tools.description: Delete a track. NOTE: indices of all later tracks shift down by one.

tools.name: describe_capabilities
tools.description:
A high-level map of this server: the tool groups and what each covers, plus
the conventions to follow, so you can orient before your first call. Set
ABLETON_TOOLSETS to load only some groups. For the current live state, call
get_session_snapshot; for mix problems, analyze_mix.

tools.name: describe_device
tools.description:
Return curated guidance for a common Ableton native device: which parameters
matter, their units (note `curve` = perceptual, not proportional), sensible
values, and mixing tips. `device_name` is case-insensitive (e.g. "EQ Eight",
"Compressor", "Glue Compressor", "Reverb", "Auto Filter", "Saturator",
"Utility", "Limiter", "Delay"). Pair with get_device_parameters for the live
indices and ranges.

tools.name: describe_live_access
tools.description: Describe executable coverage and limits, without implying complete UI access.

tools.name: describe_tool_families
tools.description:
Group the arrangement, rack, plugin-alias and song-draft tools with the
existing names. Read-only map, not a full catalog and not a rename.

tools.name: describe_warp_workflow
tools.description: List implemented warp analysis, preview repair and runtime limits.

tools.name: detect_clip_key
tools.description:
Detect the key/scale of one Session MIDI clip (Krumhansl-Kessler). Reads
the clip's notes and returns the best-fit key with a confidence (-1..1),
margin over the runner-up, and the runner-up key. `weight` is how notes are
weighted into the pitch-class histogram: "duration" (default), "velocity",
"product", or "count". Reads only; changes nothing.

tools.name: detect_session_key
tools.description:
Detect the overall key/scale of the whole set by pooling the notes of
every MIDI track's Session clips (Krumhansl-Kessler). Gives the harmonic
center of the arrangement as a whole. `weight` selects the histogram
weighting ("duration", "velocity", "product", "count"). Reads only.

tools.name: detect_track_key
tools.description:
Detect the key/scale of a whole track by pooling the notes of every
Session clip it holds (Krumhansl-Kessler). Useful when a part is spread
across several clips. `weight` selects the histogram weighting ("duration",
"velocity", "product", "count"). Reads only; changes nothing.

tools.name: duplicate_clip_to
tools.description:
Copy a Session clip to any other track/scene slot (overwrites the
destination slot). The cross-track way to build variations.

tools.name: duplicate_scene
tools.description:
Insert a copy of one Session scene, including every clip in its row.

This creates new content and increases the scene count; later scene indices
shift to make room. Use duplicate_track for a whole track or duplicate_clip_to
for one clip. Use the new scene as an editable section variation.

tools.name: duplicate_to_arrangement
tools.description:
Copy a Session-view clip into the Arrangement timeline.

OVERWRITES whatever already occupies the destination range on that track
(like recording over tape) - this is also the supported way to REPLACE a
section. Uses Live's track.duplicate_clip_to_arrangement() API (Live 11/12).
The clip is placed at destination_time beats from the start of the
arrangement on the same track it lives in.

Typical workflow:
  1. create_clip / add_notes_to_clip to build a Session clip
  2. Call duplicate_to_arrangement once per bar/section you need
  3. Call switch_to_arrangement_view to confirm the result in Live

Parameters:
- track_index:       Index of the track that owns the Session clip
- clip_index:        Index of the clip slot in that track (Session view)
- destination_time:  Beat position in the arrangement to place the clip
                     (e.g. 0.0 = start, 8.0 = bar 3 in 4/4)

tools.name: duplicate_track
tools.description:
Insert a copy of one regular track, including its devices and clips.

This creates new content and increases the track count; later track indices
shift to make room. Use duplicate_scene for a Session row or duplicate_clip_to
for one clip. Rename or edit the copy to create a variation.

track_index.description: Zero-based index of a regular track in the Live set.
track_index.title: Track Index

tools.name: edit_notes
tools.description:
Edit a subset of notes in a MIDI clip without rewriting all of them.
add = [{pitch,start_time,duration,velocity,mute}], remove = [{pitch,start_time}] (matched by pitch+start).

tools.name: fire_clip
tools.description:
Launch one existing Session-view clip using Live's launch quantization.

The slot must contain a clip. Launching it takes Session control of that
track and replaces any other playing Session clip on the same track; firing
an already-playing clip may retrigger it according to its launch settings.
Use fire_scene to launch a whole row, or continue_playing for transport only.

track_index.description: Zero-based index of a regular track in the Live set.
track_index.title: Track Index

clip_index.description: Zero-based Session-view clip-slot index on the track.
clip_index.title: Clip Index

tools.name: fire_scene
tools.description:
Launch a Session-view scene using Live's launch quantization.

This fires the row's clips together and can replace or stop clips currently
playing on the affected tracks according to each slot's launch behavior.
Use fire_clip to launch only one track's clip, or start_playback when the
intent is Arrangement transport rather than Session launching.

tools.name: generate_additive
tools.description:
Write a Philip-Glass additive process into a Session clip. REPLACES the
clip's notes if it already exists.

Builds a short one-voice motif (each pitch a ``note_length``-beat note, back
to back) from ``pitches`` -- a space-/comma-separated list of MIDI numbers.
Then plays the first 1 note, then the first 2, then the first 3 ...
concatenated end to end, so the phrase audibly grows one note per stage.
``steps`` is how many stages to build (0 = use every note; capped at the
number of pitches).

If ``source_clip_index`` is given, the motif is read from that clip on the
same track instead of built from ``pitches``. Returns a short summary.

tools.name: generate_bassline
tools.description:
Write a bassline following a chord progression. REPLACES existing notes.

progression: same syntax as generate_chord_progression.
style: "roots" (long root notes), "root_fifth" (root + fifth bounce),
"walking" (root, approach tones), "eighth_pump" (driving 8ths on the root).
octave: 1 = very low (C1=24), 2 = typical bass (C2=36).

tools.name: generate_chord_progression
tools.description:
Generate voiced chords and write them into one Session-view MIDI clip.

DESTRUCTIVE: creates a clip when the slot is empty; otherwise resizes its loop
and replaces every existing note. The track must accept MIDI. Progressions
accept dash/comma/space-separated symbols such as `Am9-Fmaj7-Cmaj9-G13`;
supported qualities include maj7, m7, m9, 9, 13, 7#9, sus4, dim, and add9.
Use add_notes_to_clip for exact notes or edit_notes to preserve existing ones.

track_index.description: Zero-based index of a regular track in the Live set.
track_index.title: Track Index

clip_index.description: Zero-based Session-view clip-slot index on the track.
clip_index.title: Clip Index

progression.description: Dash-, comma-, or space-separated chord symbols, e.g. "Dm7-G7-Cmaj7".
progression.title: Progression

beats_per_chord.description: Positive number of beats allocated to each chord.
beats_per_chord.title: Beats Per Chord

center_pitch.description: MIDI pitch around which chord voicings are centered.
center_pitch.title: Center Pitch

strum.description: Beat offset between chord tones; 0 produces block chords.
strum.title: Strum

rhythm.description: Chord rhythm: held, two stabs per slot, or quarter-note hits.
rhythm.title: Rhythm

tools.name: generate_drum_pattern
tools.description:
Write a genre drum pattern into a Session clip on a Drum Rack track.
REPLACES the clip's notes if the clip exists.

style: lofi | boom_bap | house | techno | trap | dnb | ambient.
swing: beats to delay 8th-note offbeats (0.0-0.1; 0.06 ≈ MPC-ish).
humanize: max random velocity deviation (0 = machine-perfect).
Uses the standard Live drum map (36 kick, 38 snare, 42/46 hats...).

tools.name: generate_euclidean_drums
tools.description:
Write a Euclidean (Bjorklund) rhythm for one drum voice into a Session clip.
REPLACES the clip's notes if the clip exists.

Distributes `pulses` hits as evenly as possible across `steps` slots spanning
one bar (steps=8 -> 8th notes, 16 -> 16th notes), repeated for `bars`.
pulses=3, steps=8 is the tresillo. `rotate` shifts the pattern left by that
many steps. instrument: a drum-map name (kick/snare/chat/ohat/clap/ride/...) or
a raw MIDI number. `humanize` is max +/- velocity jitter.

tools.name: generate_genre_progression
tools.description:
Build a genre-idiomatic chord progression and write it as voiced chords.
REPLACES existing notes.

genre: lofi/boom_bap/hip_hop/trap/house/deep_house/techno/trance/dnb/rnb/
neo_soul/jazz/bossa_nova/ambient/synthwave/pop/afrobeats/amapiano/... (fuzzy
matched). The genre's scale-degree grammar is transposed into key+scale, then
voiced (see generate_voiced_progression for the style options). bars = number
of chords (the grammar loops). Returns the chord symbols it used.

tools.name: generate_groove
tools.description:
Write a pocketed drum groove into a Session clip. REPLACES existing notes.

style: lofi | boom_bap | house | trap | jazz | funk. pocket: beats to lay
every hit behind the beat (0.0-0.1). swing: off-beat hat delay (0.5 straight
.. ~0.66). ghost: 0-1 probability of soft ghost snares between backbeats.
humanize: max +/- velocity deviation. Uses the standard Live drum map.

tools.name: generate_melody
tools.description:
Write a voice-led melody over a chord progression. REPLACES existing notes.

Notes come from key+scale, biased to chord tones on strong beats, chosen by
nearest-pitch voice-leading (small steps), with optional chromatic approach
notes. progression: dash-/comma-separated symbols. key: e.g. "C", "F#", "Bb".
scale: major/minor/dorian/lydian/mixolydian/blues/bebop/minor_pentatonic/...
density: low|medium|high (note rate). phrase_arc: rising|arch|ascend_descend|
static (register contour). chromatic: 0-1 approach-note probability. low/high
bound the register (MIDI). swing: 0.5 straight .. ~0.66.

tools.name: generate_phase
tools.description:
Write a Steve-Reich phasing pattern into a Session clip. REPLACES the
clip's notes if it already exists.

Builds a short one-voice motif (each pitch a ``note_length``-beat note, back
to back) from ``pitches`` -- a space-/comma-separated list of MIDI numbers,
e.g. "60 62 64 67 69". Then stacks ``repeats`` copies of that motif, each copy
starting ``shift`` beats later than the last, so the copies drift against one
another. A ``shift`` smaller than the motif length (len(pitches)*note_length)
gives the classic overlapping phase texture; ``shift`` == motif length is a
plain loop.

If ``source_clip_index`` is given, the motif is read from that clip on the
same track instead of built from ``pitches``. Returns a short summary.

tools.name: generate_voiced_progression
tools.description:
Write voice-led jazz chord voicings into a Session clip. REPLACES existing notes.

progression: dash-/comma-separated symbols, e.g. "Am9-Dm7-G13-Cmaj7".
style: rootless (3-7-9-13 stack, no root), quartal (stacked 4ths), shell
(root-3-7), or block (close-position). Smooth voice-leading is applied between
chords. center_pitch biases register (60 = C3 in Live). voices caps notes per
chord; humanize is max +/- velocity jitter.

tools.name: generate_walking_bass
tools.description:
Write a quarter-note walking bass line under a progression. REPLACES notes.

Root on beat 1, chord/scale tones through the bar, chromatic approach into the
next chord's root on the last beat, with occasional soft ghost notes.
progression: dash-/comma-separated symbols. key/scale set the passing-tone
pool. octave: 1 = very low (C1), 2 = typical bass (C2). ghost: 0-1 offbeat
ghost-note probability.

tools.name: get_arrangement_clips
tools.description:
List all clips placed in the Arrangement timeline for a track.

Returns each clip's name, start_time, end_time, length, and type.

Parameters:
- track_index: The index of the track to inspect

tools.name: get_audio_clip_timing
tools.description:
Read every audio warp marker, source path, clip/loop/start markers,
pitch and Arrangement boundaries. Target: track_index, clip_index,
clip_view=session|arrangement and optional name/start guards. Source marker
sample_time is seconds; beat_time is clip beats. Requires EXT.4 bridge.
Does not validate audible transients or modify audio/markers.

tools.name: get_browser_items_at_path
tools.description:
Get browser items at a specific path in Ableton's browser.

Parameters:
- path: Path in the format "category/folder/subfolder"
        where category is one of the available browser categories in Ableton

tools.name: get_browser_tree
tools.description:
List the browser's top-level categories and their immediate entries.
NOTE: returns a shallow listing (no deep hierarchy) - drill down with
get_browser_items_at_path("instruments"), ...("sounds/Piano & Keys"), etc.,
or skip straight to search_browser when you know a name.
category_type: "all", "instruments", "sounds", "drums", "audio_effects", "midi_effects".

tools.name: get_clip_envelope
tools.description: Read sampled Session clip envelopes in native parameter units, with target guards.

tools.name: get_clip_info
tools.description:
Full clip state: loop points, markers, playing position, per-clip time
signature; for audio clips also file path, gain display, and warp markers.

tools.name: get_clip_notes
tools.description:
Return every MIDI note in an existing Session-view MIDI clip.

Each note includes pitch, start time, duration, velocity, and mute state;
newer Live versions may add expression fields. This is read-only and fails
for an empty slot or audio clip. Use get_clip_info for clip properties.

track_index.description: Zero-based index of a regular track in the Live set.
track_index.title: Track Index

clip_index.description: Zero-based Session-view clip-slot index on the track.
clip_index.title: Clip Index

tools.name: get_device_parameters
tools.description: List all parameters of a device on a track: names, values, ranges, display strings.

tools.name: get_device_routing
tools.description:
Read a device's audio-input (sidechain) routing: current input type/channel
and the available options. Only sidechain-capable devices (Compressor, Gate)
have this. Use the options with set_device_routing to pick a sidechain source.

tools.name: get_drum_pads
tools.description: List a Drum Rack's occupied pads (MIDI note, name, mute, solo).

tools.name: get_grooves
tools.description: List grooves in the Groove Pool (index + name) and the global groove amount.

tools.name: get_group_info
tools.description:
Report a track's group state: whether it is a foldable group track, whether
it is inside a group, its fold state, and its parent group's name.

tools.name: get_live_clip_notes
tools.description:
Read ALL MIDI notes including note IDs from Session or Arrangement,
including notes outside offset loop bounds. No partial-read fallback.
Target: track_index, clip_view=session|arrangement, clip_index and names.

tools.name: get_live_mixer
tools.description:
Read track/return/Main or nested chain volume, pan and sends. Chain target
adds device_path to its rack plus chain_index. Values include formatted units.

tools.name: get_locators
tools.description:
List arrangement locators (index, name, beat time) for structure-aware
navigation. Jump with jump_to_locator.

tools.name: get_master_device_parameters
tools.description: List parameters of a device on the Master track.

tools.name: get_master_meters
tools.description:
Read the Master track's output meters - values pinned near 1.0 during
playback mean the master is clipping; pull set_master_volume down.

tools.name: get_nested_device_parameters
tools.description:
Read nested parameters. Target: track_type, track_index, device_path
[device,chain,device,...], optional expected_track_name/expected_device_name.
Main uses track_type=master. Values are native with formatted units.

tools.name: get_rack_chains
tools.description:
List an Instrument/Effect Rack's chains and the devices inside each -
previously unreachable nested devices. Use set_chain_device_parameter to
control them.

tools.name: get_return_device_parameters
tools.description:
List parameters of a device on a Return track: names, values, min/max,
display strings. Call before set_return_device_parameter.

tools.name: get_return_tracks
tools.description: List return tracks (index + name).

tools.name: get_scale_info
tools.description:
Read the song's scale and tuning: scale name, root note, scale intervals, and
the active tuning system (microtonal, Live 12.3+) if any. Set the scale with
set_song_scale; tune device parameters (e.g. Wavetable) with set_device_parameter.

tools.name: get_scenes
tools.description:
List every scene with its index, name, colour, tempo and how many tracks hold a
clip in it. Read-only. Needs the EXT.12 bridge.

tools.name: get_session_info
tools.description:
Return global Live-set and transport state without modifying the set.

Includes tempo, song time signature, playback position/state, Arrangement
loop, track/return/scene counts, scene names, key/scale, record mode, launch
quantization, Master volume/pan, and Live version. Use get_track_info for a
single track's clips/devices, or get_session_snapshot for a compact overview
of every track.

tools.name: get_session_snapshot
tools.description:
One-call overview of the whole set: tempo, time signature, play state, and
for every track its name, type, mute/solo/arm, volume, clip count, and device
names, plus return-track names. Prefer this over many get_track_info calls.

tools.name: get_sound_design_parameters
tools.description: Inspect Live parameter names, raw ranges, displayed values and enum options. Raw 0..1 values may be nonlinear; do not assume Hz/dB/ms. Top-level devices only.

tools.name: get_track_info
tools.description:
Return detailed state for one regular track without modifying the set.

Includes name/type, mixer and arm/mute/solo state, sends, freeze/color state,
playing/fired slot indices, every Session slot's basic clip state, and the
device-chain names/types. Use get_session_info for global transport state,
get_device_parameters for parameter values, or get_clip_info for full clip
properties.

track_index.description: Zero-based index of a regular track in the Live set.
track_index.title: Track Index

tools.name: get_track_meters
tools.description:
Read a track's output level meters (post-fader): left/right 0.0-1.0ish
(0.85 ≈ 0 dB, like faders). Poll during playback to judge balance/clipping -
this is how you 'listen' without exporting.

tools.name: get_track_routing
tools.description:
Read a track's input/output routing (current + all available options)
and monitoring state (0=In, 1=Auto, 2=Off). Routing options are identified
by display_name - use those strings with set_track_routing.

tools.name: groove_alignment_report
tools.description:
Per-note offset from each source note to its nearest target event, plus mean,
spread, min and max. notes are {pitch, start_time} in a shared beat timeline.
Nearest-event matching only: different instrument roles can pair by accident, and
intentional swing is not an error. No Live access or changes.

tools.name: groove_marker_plan
tools.description:
Plan warp markers from explicit source/target note lists: original_beat,
target_beat and seconds per marker, with minimum offset, spacing, density, pitch
filter and caps. Writes nothing. Apply to a fresh duplicate only and audition;
wrong note pairing or intentional swing can produce musically wrong markers.

tools.name: groove_offset_report
tools.description:
Compare two explicit beat-position lists to the grid and recommend one constant
shift. Only events within tolerance of a grid line are averaged. Reports ms and
beats plus how many events were used. A constant shift corrects feel, not phrase
structure: audition before moving clips. No Live access or changes.

tools.name: guide_halftime_remix_workflow
tools.description:
Guide remix creation in small decision groups. Select source clips, read their
MIDI/timing, plan a drop, build through existing Live tools, audition, then refine.
Returns pending decisions or a plan; never silently edits the set.

tools.name: guide_song_draft
tools.description:
Ask at most three questions (genre, energy, key), then return a 4/4 sketch.
Genres are house, hip_hop, pop and melodic. Dubstep, riddim and half-time
redirect to guide_halftime_remix_workflow. No Live writes and no playback.

tools.name: humanize_clip
tools.description:
Read a MIDI clip, apply timing + velocity humanization, and write it back.
REPLACES the clip's notes with the jittered version.

timing: max +/- start-time deviation in beats. velocity: max +/- velocity
deviation. Pitches are preserved; times stay non-negative. seed makes it
reproducible.

tools.name: inject_saved_clip_envelope
tools.description:
Write one MIDI CC automation envelope into a SAVED .als with Live closed, for the
MIDI clip that starts at clip_time beats on the single track matching the name
pattern. points are clip-relative beats with normalized 0..1 values, strictly
increasing, stored as 0..127. Requires that track's ControllerTargets.<cc>, so
create the MIDI track in Live first. Dry run by default; an in-place write is
backed up and re-read. Close Live before writing: a save would overwrite this.
Verification is file-level, not a Live readback.

tools.name: insert_chain
tools.description:
Add one chain to an Instrument/Effect Rack and verify the chain count grew by
exactly one. Refuses when this Live build does not expose RackDevice.insert_chain.
One Live Undo step. Needs the EXT.12 bridge.

tools.name: insert_device_to_chain
tools.description:
Insert one native device into a rack chain by browser name and verify the device
count grew by one. Third-party and Max devices are not covered. Refuses when this
Live build does not expose Chain.insert_device. One Live Undo step. EXT.12 bridge.

tools.name: insert_live_clip_notes
tools.description:
Insert new notes into a MIDI clip without replacing existing content.
Each note needs pitch, start_time and duration; velocity defaults to 100.
Optional mute/probability/velocity_deviation/release_velocity are validated.
Name and Arrangement start guards required. Verified by readback; one Undo
step. Does not create MPE expression curves.

tools.name: inspect_live_device_tree
tools.description:
Read every nested device, chain, parameter and formatted value on a track,
return or Main. track_type=track|return|master. Bounded to 256 devices/depth 8.

tools.name: inspect_master_chain
tools.description:
Read Main/Master devices including nested rack chains, chain gain/mute,
and each parameter's formatted value, enum options and automation state.
Does not change processing or measure LUFS, true peak or gain reduction.
Requires EXT.2 Live bridge; restart Live after installing the update.

tools.name: inspect_rack
tools.description:
Read one rack's macro support and the Dry/Wet, Mix or Amount parameter on
each chain device. Read-only. Needs the EXT.13 bridge. An empty chain list
is reported, not treated as a failure.

tools.name: inspect_remix_session
inspect_sub_clip
tools.description: Check a MIDI sub clip for note overlap, register and fundamental frequencies. No audio analysis, no automatic pitch changes, no claims about clipping or phase.

tools.name: jump_by
tools.description:
Move the playhead by a relative number of beats (negative moves back).
Works during playback for on-the-fly navigation.

tools.name: jump_to_cue
tools.description:
Jump the playhead to the next locator/cue (direction >= 0) or the previous
one (direction < 0).

tools.name: jump_to_locator
tools.description: Move the playhead to a locator (index from get_locators).

tools.name: list_known_devices
tools.description: List the devices that describe_device has curated guidance for.

tools.name: list_plugin_aliases
tools.description:
List the Serum friendly-name map. These are Live parameter strings, not
stock Ableton device names, and they do not change a value by themselves.

tools.name: list_recipes
tools.description:
List the built-in composition recipes (name, description, and default
tempo/key/scale/bars), for use with apply_recipe.

tools.name: load_device_to_master
tools.description: Load a device/effect from the browser onto the Master/Main track (e.g. a limiter for mastering).

tools.name: load_device_to_return
tools.description:
Append one loadable browser device or preset to a return track's chain.

Obtain `item_uri` from search_browser. Loading selects the return track in
Live and creates a new device, so repeated calls add duplicates. Prefer audio
effects on returns; use load_instrument_or_effect for a regular track or
load_device_to_master for the Master chain.

return_index.description: Zero-based return-track index; 0 is Return A.
return_index.title: Return Index

item_uri.description: Loadable browser-item URI returned by search_browser.
item_uri.title: Item Uri

tools.name: load_drum_kit
tools.description:
Load a Drum Rack, then the first loadable kit at a browser path.

Use search_browser to obtain the rack URI and get_browser_items_at_path to
verify the kit path. This is a two-step mutation: it appends the rack first,
then loads the first loadable item found at `kit_path`. If path lookup fails,
the new empty rack remains on the track; repeated calls add more racks. Use
load_instrument_or_effect when one known browser URI is sufficient.

track_index.description: Zero-based index of a regular track in the Live set.
track_index.title: Track Index

rack_uri.description: Loadable browser-item URI returned by search_browser.
rack_uri.title: Rack Uri

kit_path.description: Slash-separated Live browser path, such as "drums/acoustic".
kit_path.title: Kit Path

tools.name: load_instrument_or_effect
tools.description:
Load an instrument or effect onto a track using its URI.

Parameters:
- track_index: The index of the track to load the instrument on
- uri: The URI of the instrument or effect to load (e.g., 'query:Synths#Instrument%20Rack:Bass:FileId_5116')

tools.name: local_onsets_to_notes
tools.description:
Measure onsets in a bounded local PCM WAV window and convert them to a note grid
for groove work; strength becomes velocity. No phoneme, lyric or pitch detection,
so the notes are rhythm only. Seconds convert at a constant BPM, so use unwarped
audio or convert with the clip's warp map first. No Live access or changes.

tools.name: map_rack_blend_macro
tools.description:
Map nested Dry/Wet, Mix or Amount parameters to one rack macro and name
that macro Blend unless macro_name is set. macro_index is 0..7. Refuses
when this Live build has no RackDevice.macro_map. Devices without a blend
parameter are skipped. One Live Undo step. Needs the EXT.13 bridge.

tools.name: mastering_recipe_catalog
tools.description: Seven advanced mastering recipes: M/S EQ, selective band dynamics, sub-aware glue, staged peak control, stereo translation, section consistency and delivery QC. Displayed-unit audition settings, primary sources and back-off criteria. Read-only; does not apply a master or measure audio.

tools.name: modify_live_clip_notes
tools.description:
Modify existing notes by note_id in Session or Arrangement without
recreating the clip. Each entry needs note_id plus pitch/start_time/duration/
velocity/mute/probability/deviation/release fields to change. Read all notes
first; names and Arrangement start guard required. Live reassigns the ID of
each edited note because the edit removes and re-adds it; other notes keep
their IDs and expression data. Does not add unrelated notes or rewrite MPE
expression curves. One Undo step.

tools.name: plan_audio_repair
tools.description:
Optional preview of repairs for the first 30 seconds of each Arrangement
audio clip's source WAV. Full-scale samples can lower clip gain. DC offset
can enable Utility's DC switch when Live exposes it. Three or more level
jumps can add one gentle Compressor. Clicks and silence gaps are listed.
Does not write or start playback.

tools.name: plan_halftime_remix_workflow
tools.description:
Plan a reusable rock/dubstep/riddim flip: source-relative riff MIDI, held roots,
half-time drums, smooth pulses, audio-link choices and verification. No Live writes.
Physical Hz/ms/dB suggestions are not native device values. Read docs/REMIX_WORKFLOW.md.

tools.name: plan_instrument_assignment
tools.description:
Optional preview of a stock placeholder for each MIDI track that has notes
and no instrument. Does not replace a loaded instrument, including an unknown
plug-in. Does not write or start playback.

tools.name: plan_remix_midi_cleanup
tools.description:
Propose transcription cleanup on a guarded MIDI clip: exact duplicates,
short fragments, overlaps, gentle nearby-grid correction and optional lowest
monophonic voice/octave register. Never key-snap or edit the original. Returns
proposed notes and counts for building a separate copy; rechecks source notes.

tools.name: plan_song_draft
tools.description:
Optional preview of a 16, 32 or 64 bar Session sketch in 4/4. Role tracks
are Drums, Bass, Chords, and Lead when energy is high. Drum pitches are
General MIDI guesses: check them with get_drum_pads. No Live writes.

tools.name: plan_track_alignment
tools.description:
Optional preview of Warp modes for arrangement audio that is already warped.
Drums and percussion use Beats, bass uses Tones, and tonal or full-mix layers
use Complex Pro. Re-Pitch and unwarped clips stay. Does not move markers or
clip starts, flip polarity, load EQ or sends, or start playback.

tools.name: plan_track_preparation
tools.description:
Optional preview of content names, role colors and muted originals.
Does not write, play, or change notes, Warp or faders. A regular track cannot
be folded; the preview says so instead of grouping tracks Live cannot group.

tools.name: prepare_remix_session
tools.description:
Bind selected riff_midi/riff/vocal/rock_context clips with fresh name/start guards,
render immutable private audio assets, and save a rebuildable plan. Each source:
{target:{track_index,clip_index,clip_view,expected_track_name,expected_clip_name,
expected_start_time},source_start?:number}. source_start uses clip beats if warped,
seconds otherwise. Optional timing_reference is a guarded audio target sharing
the correct Warp map across aligned stems; source_offset_seconds is a measured
constant correction within +/-2 seconds. No Live writes. Optional level-based vocal activity inference;
refresh_pulses reads the owned Session Pulse Input MIDI. See REMIX_V2_PLAN.md.

tools.name: preview_bass_design
tools.description: Preview exact native-device recipe and deterministic MIDI notes without touching Live. MIDI 29 is F0 in Live's octave naming; call is +12 semitones, response +24, sub stays at root.

tools.name: preview_browser_item
tools.description:
Audition a browser item (a sample, instrument, or preset) through Live's
preview tab WITHOUT loading it onto a track. `item_uri` comes from
search_browser or get_browser_items_at_path. Use stop_browser_preview to stop.

tools.name: preview_mastering_plan
tools.description: Read-only conditional mastering plan: transparent, tearout_dense, spotify_delivery. Optional measurements must come from an external meter; never inferred. Includes ordered optional stages, delivery ceiling guidance and verification steps. Does not construct a chain, set gain, measure, render or audition audio.

tools.name: preview_remix_session
tools.description:
Capture a <=60 second preview of owned remix lanes through Live Resampling;
temporarily isolate them, disarm others, disable monitoring/feedback and verify
transport after start. Restore original mixer/arm/loop/time state. Returns WAV,
measured loudness/peaks/low-band correlation and a bounded problem scan. Requires
stopped playback and no launched Session clips. Real-time capture is not audition.

tools.name: preview_warp_repair
tools.description:
Preview explicit existing-marker moves WITHOUT editing Live. Requires track
and clip names; Arrangement source requires expected_start_time. Preserves
first/hidden terminal anchors and source sample positions; detects crossing,
excessive shifts and invalid slopes. Destination is for a later duplicate,
in Arrangement beats. Token expires after 10 min and after one apply attempt.

tools.name: quantize_clip
tools.description:
Quantize a MIDI clip. grid: quarter/eighth/eighth_triplet/sixteenth/sixteenth_triplet/thirtysecond.
amount 0.0-1.0 (use <1.0 to humanize toward the grid without full snap).

tools.name: quantize_notes_to_groove
tools.description:
Snap each source note to its nearest target event within max_snap_beats, leaving
far notes unchanged, and report how many moved. Snapping removes intentional feel:
keep the original clip to compare. No Live access or changes.

tools.name: rack_variation
tools.description:
Rack macro snapshots. action: "store" (save current macros as a
variation), "recall" (restore variation `index`), "randomize" (randomize
all macro knobs - instant sound-design exploration).

tools.name: re_enable_automation
tools.description:
Restore automation that was overridden by manual parameter changes.
IMPORTANT: setting a device parameter that has an envelope overrides the
envelope until this is called.

tools.name: read_live_object
tools.description:
Read scalar properties and availability. object_type=song|track|scene|clip|chain.
Clip target: track_type, track_index, clip_view=session|arrangement, clip_index.
Scene uses scene_index. Chain uses device_path to rack and chain_index.

tools.name: record_section
tools.description:
Bounce a section of the arrangement to an audio file WITHOUT the Export
dialog, so you can hear an internal signal. Creates a temporary audio track,
routes its input to `source` ("Resampling" = the master output, or a track's
name for that track's output), arms it, and records from start_beat to end_beat
in REAL TIME (a 4-bar section takes about 4 bars of wall-clock; capped at
5 minutes). Returns the recorded WAV path. Set cleanup=False to keep the
recording track. Runs the transport and adds an arrangement clip.

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Redo the last undone action in Live.

tools.name: refine_halftime_remix_workflow
tools.description:
Revise a remix plan using explicit listening feedback: too_guttural, too_busy,
vocal_masked, kick_sub_clash, weak_transition, clicks, more_riddim, smoother.
Returns a new config with revision history. No audio audition or Live changes.

tools.name: refine_song_draft
tools.description:
Revise a sketch: more_space, more_energy, darker, brighter, shorter, longer.
Locked sections keep their notes when the form still holds them. Read-only.

tools.name: replace_simpler_sample
tools.description:
Replace a Simpler sample with an absolute local audio-file path. Requires Live 12.4+
AND runtime API support; otherwise fails before writing. Replaces musical content:
confirm the target and preserve the original set. Readback is not an audio audition.

track_index.description: Zero-based index of a regular track in the Live set.
track_index.title: Track Index

device_index.description: Zero-based device position in the target track's device chain.
device_index.title: Device Index

tools.name: resolve_plugin_parameter
tools.description:
Resolve a friendly or exact parameter name against the live device.
An exact live name wins. A Serum alias is used only when that configured
control is actually present. Read-only. No 0..1 conversion.

tools.name: retime_warp_clip
tools.description:
Rewrite a warped audio clip's marker map to one uniform source-to-beat
rate, verified by readback. Requires track and clip names; Arrangement
source requires expected_start_time. Keeps the first marker's sample, sets
the loop to the retimed span and reports the constant source offset left for
placement to correct. Retime a fresh duplicate: a failed retime leaves that
clip part edited, so delete it and start again from the source file.

tools.name: save_set
tools.description:
Save the current Live set to its existing file, if the Live API supports it
(it does not on most versions). Returns whether the API call is available and
whether the save succeeded. To save under a new name/path, use the GUI Save-As.

tools.name: scan_audio_problems
tools.description:
Scan local integer PCM WAV for measured levels/DC and suspected clicks, gaps,
near-full-scale peaks and level jumps. Returns source timestamps, evidence,
confidence and targeted repair recipes. Bounded window, not audition or automatic
smoothing. Other formats and unassessed defects are explicit. No writes.

tools.name: scan_clip_audio_problems
tools.description:
Scan the source WAV window of one explicit Session/Arrangement audio clip.
target uses track_index, clip_index, clip_view and optional name/start guards.
Rechecks clip timing after scan. Reports source seconds; effects, fades and Warp
playback are not rendered or analyzed. No edits, playback or automatic repair.

tools.name: search_browser
tools.description:
Search the Ableton browser by display name (case-insensitive substring).
Returns loadable items with their URIs for load_instrument_or_effect /
load_device_to_master / load_device_to_return.

category: optionally limit to one of "instruments", "sounds", "drums",
"audio_effects", "midi_effects", "packs" (default: search all of them).
Prefer this over walking get_browser_items_at_path when you know a name.

tools.name: search_production_recipes
tools.description:
Search the full AbletonMCPEXT reference library: bass, layering, modulation,
mastering, tutorials and artist methods. Read-only; reference entries are not
executable presets. Sources and verification limits are preserved.

tools.name: session_diff
tools.description:
Report what changed in the set since the LAST time you called this tool:
tempo/time-signature/play-state, tracks added, removed, renamed or reordered, and per-track volume,
mute, solo, arm, clip-count, and device changes. The first call records a
baseline (no diff). Track IDs are scoped to the running bridge; older bridges
cannot identify renames reliably. Call it before and after an edit to verify it took effect.

tools.name: set_ableton_link
tools.description:
Enable or disable Ableton Link, which syncs tempo and phase with other
Link-enabled apps and devices on the local network.

tools.name: set_arrangement_overdub
tools.description:
Toggle arrangement overdub: recording layers MIDI onto existing
arrangement clips instead of replacing them.

tools.name: set_arrangement_time
tools.description:
Move the arrangement playhead to a specific position.

Parameters:
- time: Position in beats from the start of the arrangement (e.g. 8.0 = bar 3 in 4/4)

tools.name: set_chain_device_parameter
tools.description:
Set a parameter on a device INSIDE a rack chain (indices from
get_rack_chains). Values clamp to the parameter's native range.

tools.name: set_clip_audio
tools.description:
Set audio-clip properties. gain 0-1, pitch_coarse semitones (-48..48), pitch_fine cents,
warping on/off, warp_mode 0=Beats 1=Tones 2=Texture 3=Re-Pitch 4=Complex 6=Complex Pro.

tools.name: set_clip_color
tools.description:
Set an existing Session clip's palette color without changing its content.

This is a visual organization change only. Use set_track_color to recolor
the track header instead. Repeating the same color has no additional effect.

track_index.description: Zero-based index of a regular track in the Live set.
track_index.title: Track Index

clip_index.description: Zero-based Session-view clip-slot index on the track.
clip_index.title: Clip Index

tools.name: set_clip_groove
tools.description: Attach a Groove Pool groove to a clip by index (swing/timing feel). Pass no groove_index to clear.

tools.name: set_clip_loop
tools.description:
Update selected loop and launch markers on one existing Session clip.

Provide at least one optional field; omitted fields stay unchanged. `start`
and `end` are loop-brace positions in clip-relative beats and end must be
after start. `start_marker` controls where non-looped launch begins;
`looping` enables or disables repetition. Use set_loop for the Arrangement's
global loop region, not a clip, and get_clip_info to inspect current values.

track_index.description: Zero-based index of a regular track in the Live set.
track_index.title: Track Index

clip_index.description: Zero-based Session-view clip-slot index on the track.
clip_index.title: Clip Index

start.description: Optional position in beats from the start of the clip.
start.title: Start

end.description: Optional position in beats from the start of the clip.
end.title: End

start_marker.description: Optional position in beats from the start of the clip.
start_marker.title: Start Marker

looping.description: Optional state change: true turns it on, false turns it off.
looping.title: Looping

tools.name: set_clip_name
tools.description:
Rename an existing Session-view clip without changing its notes or audio.

The slot must contain a clip. Use this for the clip label; use set_track_name
for the track label. Repeating the same name has no additional effect.

track_index.description: Zero-based index of a regular track in the Live set.
track_index.title: Track Index

clip_index.description: Zero-based Session-view clip-slot index on the track.
clip_index.title: Clip Index

name.description: New display name for the Live object.
name.title: Name

tools.name: set_clip_signature
tools.description: Set a clip's own time signature (polymeter / odd-bar loops).

tools.name: set_clip_trigger_quantization
tools.description:
Global launch quantization for firing clips/scenes. 0=None (instant,
good for auditioning), 4=1 bar (default), 7=1/4 note, 13=1/32.

tools.name: set_crossfade_assign
tools.description:
Assign one regular track to crossfader side A, neither side, or side B.

This configures which side affects the track; it does not move the crossfader
or change track volume immediately. Use set_crossfader afterward to blend the
A/B groups. Repeating the same assignment has no additional effect.

track_index.description: Zero-based index of a regular track in the Live set.
track_index.title: Track Index

assign.description: Crossfader assignment: 0 is A, 1 is none, 2 is B.
assign.title: Assign

tools.name: set_crossfader
tools.description: Set the master crossfader (-1.0 = full A, 0 = center, 1.0 = full B).

tools.name: set_device_enabled
tools.description:
Enable or bypass one device on a regular track.

`true` turns the device on; `false` bypasses its processing while preserving
the device and parameter values. This changes audible signal flow but not
clip content. Use set_track_mute to silence the whole track, or
set_device_parameter to change one control.

track_index.description: Zero-based index of a regular track in the Live set.
track_index.title: Track Index

device_index.description: Zero-based device position in the target track's device chain.
device_index.title: Device Index

enabled.description: True turns the requested state on; false turns it off.
enabled.title: Enabled

tools.name: set_device_parameter

track_index.description: Zero-based index of a regular track in the Live set.
track_index.title: Track Index

device_index.description: Zero-based device position in the target track's device chain.
device_index.title: Device Index

parameter.description: Parameter name or zero-based parameter index returned by the matching get_*_device_parameters tool.
parameter.title: Parameter

value.description: Native number (clamped/quantized), exact enum label, or display text with Hz/kHz/ms/s/dB/% units, e.g. '250 Hz'. Unsupported mappings fail before writing.
value.title: Value

tools.name: set_device_routing
tools.description:
Set a device's sidechain audio input. `field` is "input_routing_type" (the
source track/return) or "input_routing_channel" (Pre FX / Post FX / Post Mixer);
`display_name` is one of the options from get_device_routing. For ducking, also
enable the device's Sidechain parameter via set_device_parameter.

tools.name: set_drum_pad
tools.description:
Mute/solo/rename a single Drum Rack pad by its MIDI note (e.g. 36=kick).
Per-pad muting = instant beat variations without touching the notes.

tools.name: set_eq_bands
tools.description:
Set several EQ Eight bands in one call on the clip's or track's EQ Eight.
bands entries take band 1..8 plus any of filter_on, frequency_hz, gain_db, q.
Frequencies and gains are reached through the parameter's own display string,
not a guessed log formula, and every written band is read back. mode is A or B.
Bands with no field are refused. One Live Undo step. Needs the EXT.12 bridge.

tools.name: set_fold_state
tools.description:
Fold (collapse) or unfold a group track. Errors if the track is not a group
track (see get_group_info).

tools.name: set_groove_amount
tools.description:
Set the global Groove Amount (0.0 to 1.0), which scales how strongly every
clip's assigned groove is applied across the whole set.

tools.name: set_live_mixer
tools.description:
Set track/return/Main or rack-chain mixer: volume, pan, send:N. Native
values, not assumed dB. Read mixer first. Track and chain name guards,
automated-control refusal, verified readback, rollback and one Undo step.

tools.name: set_loop
tools.description:
Set the global Arrangement loop region and its enabled state.

`start` is an absolute beat and `length` is a positive beat duration. The
region is updated even when `enabled=false`; playback simply will not repeat
it. Use set_clip_loop for a Session clip's loop braces, not the Arrangement.

start.description: Position in beats from the start of the Arrangement.
start.title: Start

length.description: Positive duration or region length in beats.
length.title: Length

enabled.description: True turns the requested state on; false turns it off.
enabled.title: Enabled

tools.name: set_master_device_parameter
tools.description:
Set one enabled parameter on a device in the Master track's chain.

Call get_master_device_parameters first and use its parameter name/index and
native min/max; numeric out-of-range values are clamped. Display strings with
supported units or exact enum labels also work; unsupported mappings fail
before writing. This affects the full mix. Read back the resulting display.
Use set_device_parameter for a regular track or
set_return_device_parameter for a return track.

device_index.description: Zero-based device position in the target track's device chain.
device_index.title: Device Index

parameter.description: Parameter name or zero-based parameter index returned by the matching get_*_device_parameters tool.
parameter.title: Parameter

value.description: Native number (clamped/quantized), exact enum label, or display text with Hz/kHz/ms/s/dB/% units, e.g. '250 Hz'. Unsupported mappings fail before writing.
value.title: Value

tools.name: set_master_volume
tools.description: Set the Main/Master track volume. Range 0.0-1.0 where 0.85 = 0 dB.

tools.name: set_metronome
tools.description: Turn Live's metronome click on/off.

tools.name: set_nested_device_parameters
tools.description:
Guarded, verified nested parameter batch on track/return/Main. Read first.
Target requires expected_track_name, expected_device_name and device_path.
Native values only; refuses automated controls. Rollback and one Undo step.

tools.name: set_plugin_parameter
tools.description:
Set one plugin parameter by friendly or exact name. The value is the
parameter's native number from get_sound_design_parameters, not a guessed
0..1 amount. Resolves the live name, then uses the guarded parameter batch:
range check, readback and rollback. One Live Undo step.

tools.name: set_record_mode
tools.description:
Arm or disarm Live's global Arrangement Record state.

`true` enables Arrangement recording; `false` disables it. Enabling alone
does not record: arm the intended tracks with set_track_arm, then use
start_playback. Use set_session_record or trigger_session_record for Session
slots instead. Repeating the current state has no additional effect.

enabled.description: True turns the requested state on; false turns it off.
enabled.title: Enabled

tools.name: set_return_device_parameter
tools.description:
Set one enabled parameter on a device in a return track's chain.

Call get_return_device_parameters first and use its parameter name/index and
native min/max; numeric out-of-range values are clamped. Supported display-unit
strings and exact enum labels also work; unsupported mappings fail before writing.
Use set_device_parameter for
a regular track or set_master_device_parameter for the full-mix chain.

return_index.description: Zero-based return-track index; 0 is Return A.
return_index.title: Return Index

device_index.description: Zero-based device position in the target track's device chain.
device_index.title: Device Index

parameter.description: Parameter name or zero-based parameter index returned by the matching get_*_device_parameters tool.
parameter.title: Parameter

value.description: Native number (clamped/quantized), exact enum label, or display text with Hz/kHz/ms/s/dB/% units, e.g. '250 Hz'. Unsupported mappings fail before writing.
value.title: Value

tools.name: set_scene_name
tools.description:
Rename one Session-view scene without changing any clips in the row.

Use set_clip_name for an individual clip. Repeating the same name has no
additional effect.

name.description: New display name for the Live object.
name.title: Name

tools.name: set_send
tools.description: Set a track's send level (send_index 0 = Return A, 1 = Return B, ...). Range 0.0-1.0.

tools.name: set_session_automation_record
tools.description:
Toggle recording of parameter changes into Session clip envelopes -
an alternative to write_automation for captured knob rides.

tools.name: set_session_record
tools.description:
Toggle Session record (records into armed tracks' selected Session slots;
also enables MIDI overdub into playing clips).

tools.name: set_simpler_playback_mode
tools.description:
Set a Simpler device's playback mode: 0 = Classic, 1 = One-Shot, 2 = Slicing.
Slicing chops the sample into playable slices, central to lofi/hip-hop
sampling. Errors if the device at that index is not a Simpler.

tools.name: set_song_scale
tools.description:
Set the song's key context. root_note 0-11 (0=C, 2=D...), scale_name e.g.
"Major", "Minor", "Dorian". Read current values via get_session_info.

tools.name: set_sound_design_parameters
tools.description: Set an exact-name parameter batch in native API units with validation, readback and rollback on failure. Refuses automated controls. One Live Undo step per batch. Integer coarse/fractional fine tuning must be separate controls. Use parameter inspection first.

tools.name: set_swing_amount
tools.description: Set the global swing amount (0.0 to 1.0) used when quantizing with swing.

tools.name: set_tempo
tools.description:
Set the tempo of the Ableton session.

Parameters:
- tempo: The new tempo in BPM

tools.name: set_time_signature
tools.description:
Set the Live set's global time signature, such as 4/4, 3/4, or 6/8.

This changes bar/grid and metronome interpretation but does not rewrite clip
notes. Use set_clip_signature instead when only one clip needs a different
meter for polymeter. Repeating the same signature has no additional effect.

numerator.description: Number of beats per bar, such as 4 in 4/4.
numerator.title: Numerator

denominator.description: Beat-note denominator, such as 4 in 4/4 or 8 in 6/8.
denominator.title: Denominator

tools.name: set_track_arm
tools.description:
Arm or disarm a track for recording (fails on tracks that can't be armed,
e.g. group/return tracks).

tools.name: set_track_color
tools.description: Set a track's color by index (0-69 in Live's palette).

tools.name: set_track_monitoring
tools.description:
Set input monitoring: 0=In (always hear input), 1=Auto, 2=Off.
Required for resampling/bounce workflows.

tools.name: set_track_mute
tools.description:
Set one regular track's mute state (`true` mutes; `false` unmutes).

Muting silences that track in Live but preserves its clips, devices, and
mixer settings. Use set_track_solo to audition a track relative to the rest,
or stop_clip when only Session clip playback should stop.

track_index.description: Zero-based index of a regular track in the Live set.
track_index.title: Track Index

mute.description: True turns the requested state on; false turns it off.
mute.title: Mute

tools.name: set_track_name
tools.description:
Set the name of a track.

Parameters:
- track_index: The index of the track to rename
- name: The new name for the track

tools.name: set_track_pan
tools.description:
Set one regular track's stereo pan position; 0.0 is centered.

Live clamps the value to the track's native range. This changes mixer state,
not the audio file or clip content. Use set_master_device_parameter for a
device control, and set_crossfader for A/B crossfading.

track_index.description: Zero-based index of a regular track in the Live set.
track_index.title: Track Index

tools.name: set_track_routing
tools.description:
Set track routing by display name. field: input_routing_type |
output_routing_type | input_routing_channel | output_routing_channel.
Enables sidechain sources, bus routing, and resampling (route a track's
output into another track's input, arm, record). Get options from
get_track_routing first.

tools.name: set_track_solo
tools.description:
Set one regular track's solo state (`true` solos; `false` unsolos).

Solo changes monitoring relative to other tracks and does not alter clip or
device content. Other tracks may remain soloed, so clear them separately when
exclusive auditioning is required. Use set_track_mute to silence this track.

track_index.description: Zero-based index of a regular track in the Live set.
track_index.title: Track Index

solo.description: True turns the requested state on; false turns it off.
solo.title: Solo

tools.name: set_track_volume
tools.description: Set track volume. Range 0.0-1.0 where 0.85 = 0 dB (unity gain).

tools.name: setup_session
tools.description:
Bootstrap a session in one call: set tempo and create named MIDI tracks,
optionally loading an instrument found by name for each.

tracks: [{"name": "Drums", "instrument": "drum kit"}, {"name": "Bass",
"instrument": "upright bass"}, ...]. "instrument" is a search_browser query
(best match is loaded); omit it to create an empty track.
Returns a per-track report with the loaded item names.

tools.name: start_playback
tools.description:
Start Arrangement playback from the current song time. NOTE: the response
reports the PRE-command state (may say playing=false right after starting) -
confirm with get_session_info.

tools.name: stop_all_clips
tools.description: Stop every playing Session clip (does not stop the transport).

tools.name: stop_browser_preview
tools.description: Stop the browser preview started by preview_browser_item.

tools.name: stop_clip
tools.description:
Stop playing a clip.

Parameters:
- track_index: The index of the track containing the clip
- clip_index: The index of the clip slot containing the clip

tools.name: stop_playback
tools.description:
Stop playback. NOTE: the response reports the PRE-command state - confirm
with get_session_info.

tools.name: switch_to_arrangement_view
tools.description:
Switch Ableton's main window to the Arrangement view.

Parameters:

tools.name: tap_tempo
tools.description:
Tap the tempo once. Tapping repeatedly at a beat sets the tempo to that
rate; a single tap nudges the transport. Returns the resulting tempo.

tools.name: tearout_gun_blueprint
tools.description: BassTi tutorial-informed four-layer gun workflow and synchronized triplet MIDI material. Separates timestamped caption evidence from native adaptations. Read-only: does not build routing/racks or claim exact third-party settings. Use tearout_triplet in phrase tools for executable MIDI.

tools.name: transform_clip
tools.description:
Read a MIDI clip's notes, apply a classical motif transformation, and write
the result. Overwrites the source clip unless ``dest_clip_index`` is given
(in which case that destination slot is REPLACED instead).

op (one of):
  transpose  - shift every pitch by ``amount`` semitones (integer; may be
               negative). Timing unchanged; out-of-range pitches clamped.
  invert     - mirror pitches about the first note's pitch (up-motion becomes
               down-motion). ``amount`` is ignored.
  retrograde - play the motif backwards in time (onset order reversed,
               durations preserved). ``amount`` is ignored.
  augment    - scale start times and durations by ``amount`` (a factor > 1
               stretches/slows, 0 < ``amount`` < 1 compresses/speeds up).
               Requires ``amount`` > 0.

``amount`` therefore means semitones for transpose and a time factor for
augment. Returns a short summary of what was written.

tools.name: trigger_session_record
tools.description:
Start Session recording into armed tracks; record_length in beats records
a fixed-length loop (e.g. 16.0 = 4 bars) then auto-switches to playback.

tools.name: undo
tools.description:
Revert the most recent undoable Live-set action.

This mutates the set and may remove newly created content or restore deleted
content. It has no target parameter: Live chooses the top undo-history entry.
Use redo to reapply an accidental undo. Prefer batch_commands for related
edits so one undo reverts the group.

tools.name: write_automation
tools.description:
Write clip automation for a device parameter. points = [{"time": beats, "value": v}, ...].
Replaces any existing envelope for that parameter on the clip.

tools.name: write_clip_envelope
tools.description:
Write verified, bounded Session envelopes. Read existing envelopes before replace=true.
Native parameter values; times in clip beats. Linear curves approximate hold steps.
Arrangement editing requires copying the Session clip back. One Live Undo step.

tools.name: write_drum_grid
tools.description:
Write drums from an ASCII grid (16th-note steps). REPLACES existing notes.

grid: one line per instrument: "name: pattern" where pattern chars are
'X' (accent, vel 105), 'x' (normal, 85), 'o' (soft, 55), '.' or '-' (rest).
Line length = number of 16th steps (16 = one 4/4 bar; 32 = two bars...).
Instruments: kick snare rim clap chat phat ohat ltom mtom htom crash ride perc shaker,
or a raw MIDI number ("36: x...").

Example (one bar of lofi):
  kick:  X..x......X.....
  snare: ....x.......x...
  chat:  x.o.x.o.x.o.x.o.

tools.name: write_live_object
tools.description:
Write exposed song/track/scene/clip/chain properties after read_live_object.
Only documented allowlisted fields; native units. Name guards required for
track/clip/chain; Arrangement writes require expected_start_time. Validated
whole batch, readback, rollback and one Undo. No arbitrary property access.
